critical_code_review_comments: DesignStudio.jsx is already very large (>1200 lines) with wizard/canvas/AI/bulk logic mixed; consider splitting bulk-print dialog into its own component for maintainability.

/api/studio/payments/bulk-print/create returns nested {data:{link}} PayTR shape; the AI paid-flow uses similar shape — FE must handle both consistently. Consider a helper util to unwrap PayTR responses.

print-consume relies on user.role check ('admin','staff') for unlimited bypass while bulk-print-pdf endpoint does NOT enforce capacity (any authenticated user can render). This is fine per spec but worth noting — server should still not be used as a free rendering service without capacity checks at some layer if abuse is a concern.
